title: Alert Using Same Key Card Three Or More Times In A One Hour Period
description: Find names of workers who used their key card three or more times within a one-hour period.
pseudocode:
1. map = {}
2. for (name, time) in logs:
3.   minutes = convertToMinutes(time)
4.   map[name].push(minutes)
5. for name in map:
6.   times = sort(map[name])
7.   for i from 2 to times.length - 1:
8.     if times[i] - times[i-2] <= 60:
9.       alerted.push(name); break

steps.note: Initialize empty frequency map for logs.
50 <= 60, condition met. Adding 'daniel' to alerted list.
